dedupe_keys.name: gisfire wildfire data and analysis applications

description: GisFIRE is Jaume Figueras and contributors' software for wildfire data preparation, analysis and firefighting research. Its current documentation describes import pipelines for fire perimeters and geographic information, linkage of lightning to ignitions, and planned or ported modelling and aerial-logistics functions. Inputs are provider datasets and spatial settings; implemented import applications produce PostGIS records and source-specific analysis outputs. Coverage follows the selected provider, with examples spanning European and American fire inventories, not one common period or resolution. Code is free under GPL-3.0, with Python command-line applications and a documented API and QGIS architecture. A limitation is that this successor to GisFIRE2 is still being ported: the documentation explicitly says some sections describe scaffolded structure, so all listed algorithms should not be assumed complete. It can prepare wildfire inputs for infrastructure hazard simulations. The Tsolakis fire simulator (model-tsolakis-fire-simulator) offers related exploratory spread modelling. No fire records or database was downloaded.
